name: socialcrawl-unified-social-media-api
title: SocialCrawl — Unified Social Media Data API
description: One API key for 48 platforms across 381 endpoints — social, commerce, app-store, review, places & travel, web-scraping and web-research — plus universal cross-platform search, Prism composites, scheduled monitors, auto-pagination, full per-endpoint credit pricing, and a free self-documenting surface (quickstart, per-endpoint guides, and an llms.txt context corpus for AI agents), behind one unified response envelope.
